requirements.title: SMS language and delivery status
requirements.description: The system shall send every SMS in the applicant's chosen language, Hindi or English, using DLT-registered templates, and record the delivery status of each message.
acceptanceCriteria: Given an applicant who chose Hindi, when any SMS is triggered, then the Hindi template is used and the delivery report is stored.
